audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Care for the poor, sickness, betrayal, enemies, and restoration.

verses.restored: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: YHWH will deliver him in time of trouble.

familiar.text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.

modern.text: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד אַ֭שְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּ֣יל אֶל דָּ֑ל בְּי֥וֹם רָ֝עָ֗ה יְֽמַלְּטֵ֥הוּ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: YHWH will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him to the will of his enemies.

familiar.text: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

modern.text: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.

original.text: יְהוָ֤ה יִשְׁמְרֵ֣הוּ וִֽ֭יחַיֵּהוּ יאשר בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְאַֽל תִּ֝תְּנֵ֗הוּ בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבָֽיו

verses.restored: YHWH will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

familiar.text: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

modern.text: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.

original.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְעָדֶנּוּ עַל עֶ֣רֶשׂ דְּוָ֑י כָּל מִ֝שְׁכָּב֗וֹ הָפַ֥כְתָּ בְחָלְיֽוֹ

verses.restored: I said, YHWH, be merciful to me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

familiar.text: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

modern.text: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”

original.text: אֲֽנִי אָ֭מַרְתִּי יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נִי רְפָאָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י כִּי חָטָ֥אתִי לָֽךְ

verses.restored: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

familiar.text: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

modern.text: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”

original.text: אוֹיְבַ֗י יֹאמְר֣וּ רַ֣ע לִ֑י מָתַ֥י יָ֝מ֗וּת וְאָבַ֥ד שְׁמֽוֹ

verses.restored: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

familiar.text: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

modern.text: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.

original.text: וְאִם בָּ֤א לִרְא֨וֹת שָׁ֤וְא יְדַבֵּ֗ר לִבּ֗וֹ יִקְבָּץ אָ֥וֶן ל֑וֹ יֵצֵ֖א לַח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר

verses.restored: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

familiar.text: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

modern.text: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:

original.text: יַ֗חַד עָלַ֣י יִ֭תְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל שֹׂנְאָ֑י עָלַ֓י יַחְשְׁב֖וּ רָעָ֣ה לִֽי

verses.restored: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast to him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

familiar.text: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

modern.text: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”

original.text: דְּֽבַר בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָצ֣וּק בּ֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ב לֹא יוֹסִ֥יף לָקֽוּם

verses.restored: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

familiar.text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

modern.text: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

original.text: גַּם אִ֤ישׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֨י אֲשֶׁר בָּטַ֣חְתִּי ב֭וֹ אוֹכֵ֣ל לַחְמִ֑י הִגְדִּ֖יל עָלַ֣י עָקֵֽב

verses.restored: But thou, O YHWH, be merciful to me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

familiar.text: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

modern.text: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה חָנֵּ֥נִי וַהֲקִימֵ֑נִי וַֽאֲשַׁלְּמָ֥ה לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

familiar.text: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

modern.text: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

original.text: בְּזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי חָפַ֣צְתָּ בִּ֑י כִּ֤י לֹֽא יָרִ֖יעַ אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי

verses.restored: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

familiar.text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

modern.text: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּ֭תֻמִּי תָּמַ֣כְתָּ בִּ֑י וַתַּצִּיבֵ֖נִי לְפָנֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: Blessed be YHWH God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

familiar.text: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

modern.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

original.text: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵֽ֭הָעוֹלָם וְעַ֥ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן וְאָמֵֽן

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Sickness is not evidence of guilt, and care for poor people is not transactional magic guaranteeing health.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
